messages:
Mira: @eng-runtime FYI CedarWorks (dedicated pool) is seeing tail latency spikes and wants a batching/queue tweak for their reserved capacity. They gave us a profiling dump — looks like KV cache churn + lots of tiny batches. Can someone take first pass on safe token_budget/queue changes?

Jon: on it. do we have the current config for that pool?

Mira: current: token_budget=1024, queue_ceiling=256, batch_wait_ms=8. GPU: A10G x4, host mem ~128GB. Observed p95/p99 and profiler below.

Kai: posting quick profiler summary from their trace:
```
PROFILE SNAPSHOT (sampled):
- kernel: attn_fused                 62%
- kernel: kv_cache_lookup            18%
- kernel: load_weights               10%
- other (io/dispatch)                10%
- avg batch size: 3.2 (peak small batches)
- kv miss rate: 28% over 15m window
- p95 latency: 180ms, p99: 420ms, tail spikes up to 900ms during bursts
- steady-state throughput dip when many short requests come in
```

Casey: kv miss rate that high + tiny batches = cache churn + kernel launch overhead. CedarWorks has high prefix diversity (lots of short, unique prompts).

Kai: two levers: increase token_budget & queue_ceiling so batching aggregates more tokens before dispatch, and tweak batch_wait_ms so we wait slightly longer for coalescing. Also consider kv_prefetch to reduce lookup stalls for requests that cross time window thresholds.

Mira: proposed quick canary: token_budget=2048, queue_ceiling=512, batch_wait_ms=12, kv_prefetch=true, canary_pct=10 for 2 hours. Thoughts on memory pressure?

Casey: safe as long as memory_threshold_pct is set. GPUs have ~40GB VRAM each; with A10Gx4 pool it's ok, but add memory_threshold_pct: 85 to trigger shedding before OOM. Also set per-instance max_batch_tokens to avoid runaway.

Jon: agree. also add fallback: if p99 > 600ms for 3 consecutive minutes, route new requests to model-variant:small as graceful degradation. That keeps SLA.

Elena: I'll capture a kernel timeline and NVTX trace during the canary to validate kv-prefetch effect. Please make sure tracing hooks enabled (debug-level sampling 1%).

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled for pool cedarworks-dedicated at 1866005000 (10% traffic, 2h). :white_check_mark:

Sam: I'll coordinate with CedarWorks for a low-traffic window today 3-5pm PST and confirm.

Jon: config diff I'm going to apply to canary (local test passed):
```json
{
  "token_budget": 2048,
  "queue_ceiling": 512,
  "batch_wait_ms": 12,
  "kv_prefetch": true,
  "canary_pct": 10,
  "memory_threshold_pct": 85,
  "fallback_policy": { "p99_ms": 600, "duration_min": 3, "route": "model-variant:small" }
}
```

Casey: add a metric alert for kv_miss_rate spike and small_batch_rate > 45% so we can roll back quickly.

Kai: also tweak batching heuristic: prefer token-aware coalescing (weight by sequence length) for this pool — will push a small runtime flag.

Mira: assigned to Jon/Kai for rollout and Elena for tracing. Sam to coordinate customer window. I'll update CedarWorks once canary is live and tag them in the postmortem if we change defaults.

Jon: starting rollout in 5m to the canary group, will post initial telemetry in thread.

Elena: I created a grafana panel for quick p50/p95/p99, avg batch size, kv_miss_rate, and kernel CPU/GPU utilization — link in thread when canary starts.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1866005000. Logs: `canary/cedarworks/2026-03-18T15:10:00Z`

Mira: thanks all — please keep updates short here. If rollback needed, flash @channel and call the oncall. :thumbsup:
